summary: Current implementation satisfies the saved operation audit truth plan. OperationResponse exposes stable audit fields while preserving raw payload/result/error fields; OperationRepository centralizes start and merges log_stream_refs on finish; operator refresh, validate, cancel, stop, destroy, and remonitor payloads include owner/source/reason/reason_code/requested_action; stack-stop failures finish operations as failed with audit details; PR-monitor recovery operations include pr_monitor owner/source, requested action, recovery mode, actionable reason_code, and monitor log refs when available; executor recovery completion includes validation log refs for success and failure. Focused tests, ruff, mypy, full unit tests, and the 99% coverage gate all pass.
